in_marathi.name: Gorakshanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gorakshanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gorakshanath is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Goraksha (protector) and Nath (lord). This name signifies the one who is the lord of protection. Goraksha is an incarnation of Lord Shiva, who is known to protect his devotees from all harms.
